description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amended Gaz. Ex. No. 2082/10 of 31.07.2018, excise duty on motor cars and other motor vehicles
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that amends excise duty regulations for motor vehicles. It is an Order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which modifies previous gazette notifications regarding import duties and clearance procedures. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing regulatory changes, and it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or focus on government personnel changes. The core content is about legal/regulatory amendments to excise provisions.
